## C+E. Evidence fidelity and credential-safe outputs — one independent worktree/owner
Files: evidence.py, absence.py, commands.py, runner.py diagnostic/redaction seam, relevant tests, Evidence/Harness docs. Integrate latest A before final validation. Own commands.py; coordinate any shared constants with B.
Evidence:
- Extend documented line/raw selector grammar while keeping exact normalized in-workspace path equality and no traversal/sibling-prefix/outside-root credit.
- ?q= reads remain uncredited: expressions compute arbitrary values (observed one-character result), unlike verbatim range/grep. Prompt D names what counts. Revisit only with preserved concrete false-negative trace.
- Successful exact archive listing/member content can credit required archive container ONLY: exact registered archive extension within root, no binary-entry notice, member path never credits a repository file. Keep errors/no-match/directory/multi-path grep uncredited. Do not blanket-exempt binaries.
- Set nested read.summarize.enabled:false in reviewer-only overlay; local real smoke must prove no summary/elision for same >100-line plain read. Keep existing partial-read policy, no rejection of summaries at gate. Preserve elided span metadata in bounded diagnostics and track zero after rollout.
- Preserve useful bounded redacted trace for failures: credited read/grep paths, elision counts, required/missing paths, rewrite labels and fingerprint; no full raw transcript. Explicit counts/truncation so output is not misleading. Keep current artifact schema if possible.
- Binary/out-of-bounds/unreviewable policy remains in named existing TODOs above, not falsely solved here. Record pinned-build notice shapes when available.
Credentials:
- One credential-name source covers forwarded OMP broker/provider env plus existing legacy extras, including OPENAI_CODEX_OAUTH_TOKEN. Remove duplicate drift without import cycles.
- Exact known-value redaction before transforms AND after sanitize transformations, before any truncation. Remove excerpt pre-redaction slice. Validator missing/extra key and ID errors, absence detail, job-summary/skip reasons, diagnostics/fingerprint and every publishable verdict text are covered.
- Redact text fields in place; a known credential in structural field (file, files_examined, prior ID or object key) invalidates with fixed safe message, never moves a finding outside scope. Include control-character split, overlapping values and truncation-straddling cases. Avoid serialize/replace that mutates structure.
- Probe tool reach with fake sentinels only; on pinned Linux inspect /proc/self/environ,/proc/<ppid>/environ, HOME config and committed symlink. Any reachable sensitive path gets an owned prerequisite TODO; do not call redaction containment. Tokens inside secret OMP_AGENT_CONFIG or dynamically brokered credentials cannot be exactly matched unless exposed through known values; document limit.
Acceptance: selector/archive positive/negative cases; zero regression in per-file evidence; useful redacted failure diagnostics; overlay real smoke; fake credentials absent from final artifacts/public summaries/errors after transforms/truncation; ordinary text/decisions unchanged. Remove obsolete commands.schema_text only once D no longer imports it, in D final integration if C lands earlier; no broken intermediate commit.
